eucalyptus_spp.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for warmer tones; iron very sparingly, for dark outlines.
pH: affects the hue, though the species of eucalyptus matters more still.
Temperature: hot extraction or steaming; a hard boil is not needed.
Eco print: one of the most useful contact materials, but the different species must not be treated as interchangeable.
eucalyptus_spp.Багрилна съставка: The leaves contain considerable tannins and flavonoids, including gallic and ellagic acid and flavonols in some species. The tannins support the direct affinity and the strong reaction with iron; the particular orange-red print depends on the species and its own phenolic profile.
eucalyptus_spp.Как се държи: The leaves can give anything from peach and rust to terracotta, brown and grey-olive; the result depends a great deal on the Eucalyptus species, the maturity of the leaves and the mordant. In eco print many species give a distinct silhouette and characteristic orange-rust tones.
eucalyptus_spp.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: during the growing season, on a dry day; choose sound, fully grown leaves and tops. For flowering herbs, from the beginning of bloom to full bloom is the most practical window.
What is gathered: leaves.
Processing: use fresh or dry in the shade, in a thin layer with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

persea_americana.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: will give colour without a metal mordant; an alum mordant helps towards an even result.
pH: neutral to slightly alkaline often strengthens the pink-brown direction; extremes of pH can change the hue.
Temperature: works with moderate heat and without a long hard boil.
Cellulose: a fairly rewarding material for cotton, though the results vary more than with the classic dye plants.
persea_americana.Багрилна съставка: The stones and skins contain polyphenols, tannins and flavonoid compounds among them. During extraction and contact with oxygen, some of the phenolics oxidise into darker pink-brown chromophores; the exact mechanism and shade depend heavily on the material and the conditions.
persea_americana.Как се държи: The stones and skins most often give peach, powdery pink and pink-brown. The colour develops gradually through extraction and oxidation and can vary noticeably with the variety, the ripeness, the water and the pH. Iron generally mutes and darkens it towards grey-brown.
persea_americana.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: as fresh kitchen waste from ripe fruit.
What is used: the stone and the skin of the fruit.
Processing: wash well; cut the stone into small pieces for easier extraction. Use fresh or freeze. To dry — cut up and dry completely before storing.
Storage: dry and dark; use fresh material soon, or freeze it.

rosa_spp.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for lighter tones; iron for dark leaf outlines.
pH: the petals are strongly pH-sensitive.
Temperature: leaves — hot extraction; flowers — gentler heat.
Eco print: the leaves are the more dependable part, for shape and for the tannin reaction.
rosa_spp.Багрилна съставка: The leaves contain tannins and flavonoids, which give the yellow-browns and the dark iron reactions. The petals contain anthocyanins, which can give beautiful pink-purple shades but are more sensitive to pH and to light.
rosa_spp.Как се държи: The leaves are the more dependable dye part and give yellow-greens, tan and grey-browns. The petals can give experimental pinks and purples, but these are more sensitive and less lasting.
rosa_spp.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: leaves · flowers.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

corylus_avellana.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for warmer yellow-ochres; iron for grey or olive.
pH: neutral is a dependable start.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Eco print: the leaves suit clear tannin silhouettes, especially under an iron modifier.
corylus_avellana.Багрилна съставка: The leaves, bark and husks contain tannins and flavonoids. The tannins give the direct affinity and the strong iron-tannin reaction, while the flavonoids contribute the yellow-ochre tones.
corylus_avellana.Как се държи: Leaves, bark and green husks give yellow, ochre, olive and grey-brown. The tannin reaction with iron is strong and can leave a distinct dark outline in eco print. The parts behave differently; the leaves are the easiest for contact printing.
corylus_avellana.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: leaves — sound and grown during the season; green husks and shells — as the nuts ripen; bark — only from prunings or cut branches.
What is used: leaves · bark · green husks · shells.
Processing: use the leaves fresh or dry them; crush the husks and shells; chop the bark small before extracting.
Storage: fully dry material, separated by part and kept in the dark.

pelargonium_zonale.Багрилна съставка: The leaves contain phenolic compounds and flavonoids, and the flowers anthocyanins depending on the variety. The anthocyanins account for the pH-sensitive pink-purple shades, but they are less lightfast than the classic textile dyes.
pelargonium_zonale.Как се държи: The leaves and flowers give beige, yellow-green and sometimes experimental pink-purple casts, according to the variety. The anthocyanin flower tones are the less lasting; the leaves are more useful for muted texture and for the iron reaction. This is not among the more dependable dye plants.
pelargonium_zonale.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for lighter tones; iron for grey-green or brown.
pH: the flower pigments are pH-sensitive.
Temperature: moderate heat; do not boil the flowers for long.
Status: an experimental or secondary plant for dyeing and eco print.
pelargonium_zonale.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flowers · leaves.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

sambucus_nigra.Багрилна съставка: The leaves and bark contain phenolic compounds and tannins, which take part in the binding and in the reaction with iron. The berries contain anthocyanins, which give the red-violet tones but are less stable to light, heat and pH.
sambucus_nigra.Как се държи: The leaves and bark give more muted yellow-greens, sage and greyish tones. The berries can give beautiful pink-violet casts, but anthocyanin colour is sensitive to pH, heat and light and suits experimental tests better.
sambucus_nigra.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: an alum mordant clears the yellow-green tones; iron darkens towards grey and olive.
pH: the berries are strongly pH-sensitive.
Temperature: for the berries, work with moderate heat; prolonged heating dulls the colour.
Cellulose: for predictable results, use a standard tannin preparation and an alum mordant.
sambucus_nigra.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: leaves — during the active season, sound and fully grown; berries — fully ripe; bark — only from prunings or already cut branches.
What is used: leaves and bark for the yellow-sage and greyish tones; ripe berries for experimental pink-violet dyes.
Processing: use the leaves fresh or dry them in the shade; cut the bark into small pieces; use the berries fresh or frozen and work at a lower temperature.
Storage: the dry parts — fully dried, in the dark; the berries — frozen or used soon.
